function.name: VarDecFromCy
function.signature: HRESULT WINAPI VarDecFromCy(CY cyIn, DECIMAL* pDecOut)
function.header_comment:
/************************************************************************
 * VarDecFromCy (OLEAUT32.196)
 *
 * Convert a VT_CY to a DECIMAL.
 *
 * PARAMS
 *  cyIn    [I] Source
 *  pDecOut [O] Destination
 *
 * RETURNS
 *  S_OK.
 */
